name: Ram cuon cai
summary: Ram cuốn cải is a fried spring roll wrapped in cabbage, at Con Market’s outdoor counters and on Phạm Hồng Thái and Phan Tứ.
origin: Con Market and the Da Nang night streets.
howToEat: Eat the cabbage and the fried roll together.
where: Con Market’s outdoor counters, from about 15:00.
Phạm Hồng Thái, after dark, from about 17:00 until after 23:00.
Phan Tứ, Ngũ Hành Sơn, in the evening, from about 17:00 to midnight.
seoTitle: Ram cuon cai — fried spring roll in cabbage
seoDescription: Ram cuốn cải is a fried spring roll wrapped in cabbage, at Con Market and on Phạm Hồng Thái and Phan Tứ.
